uncited: **Scene Grouping:** Compute pairwise Chamfer distances between the subsampled point clouds of all $N$ scenes.
- Initialize the shared context model parameters (hash grid values and MLP weights).
- Initialize scene-specific anchor attributes for all scenes in the group.
- Iterate over training images from all scenes in the group.
- For each image, sample rays and evaluate the scene function using the shared context model.
- Render the image and compute the loss against the ground truth.
- **Clustering Threshold ($\tau$):** Controls the maximum Chamfer distance for scenes to be grouped together.
